reference_behavior: The offs_real tv64 membership determines the branch for both fields; mixed scalar/wrapped layouts raise an exception.
native_behavior: Use the offs_real branch for both fields and require a base or enum scalar in the unwrapped branch; inconsistent layouts return Err.
regression: Both cases were accepted before the fix. The generated reference cases first failed the native test, then passed after the fix.
limitations: Synthetic inconsistent ISF layouts test rejection boundaries, not support for a real kernel with such a layout.
This does not establish modern time namespace real-image coverage, Intel32 platform parity or a complete plugin contract.
